How to read that evidence

Useful signal, not proven edgeHigher leans broke out more often, but they did not show better average market-relative Friday returns.
Distance mattersA stock closing near the top of Thursday’s range naturally has less ground to cover for a breakout.
No trading P&LThe study does not include entries, slippage, costs, borrow, sizing, or overlapping positions.
How the screen works and what it cannot know
1. Find the impulseLook for five trading days of market outperformance and above-normal volume.
2. Require consolidationThe next three sessions must trade in a tighter range than the stock’s recent norm.
3. Form the leanCombine how much of the move held, where Thursday closed in its range, and performance versus SPY.
Current universe limitationToday’s S&P 500 membership is projected backward, so history includes survivorship bias.
Data-vintage limitationYahoo can revise adjusted history. This is not an archived Thursday-night market-data feed.
Attention limitationPrice and volume proxy market attention; the screen does not directly measure news or social interest.
